title: Disney Admiral Mickey Mouse 8in Mini Bean Bag Plush - Used
descriptionText: The Disney Admiral Mickey Mouse Mini Bean Bag 8" Plush Toy is a cute and cuddly collectible featuring the iconic Mickey Mouse character from the Disney franchise. This plush toy is perfect for fans of Disney and collectors of contemporary plush toys. With its small size and high-quality construction, it is a great addition to any Disneyana collection.
